messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR ready but blocked awaiting architecture sign-off. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/12789. RFC anchor here: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-routing-shim.md. TL;DR: introduce lightweight routing shim to route 10% traffic to new path with automatic fallback. Need a small safety brief + canary window.
Mira: Thanks — skimmed the RFC. Can you paste the canary plan and the revert criteria here? :eyes:
Alex: Canary plan (proposal): 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 2h. Metric watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate. Revert if 5xx rate increases by >0.3pp or p95 degrades >50ms. Snippet: ```canary:\n  steps: [1,5,10]\n  watch: ["p95_latency_ms","5xx_rate"]\n  revert_thresholds:\n    5xx_rate: 0.003\n    p95_latency_ms: 50\n```
Jon: I can take a quick look today. Two asks: (1) attach perf numbers for the routing shim on p95/p99 under representative load, (2) confirm fallback path maintains KV cache semantics (we need no cold-start logic that breaks caches).
Sara: Pinged @jon on perf infra — I can run the perf job this afternoon if you give me the test harness and a small test dataset. Also, does this change touch any auth/KMS flow? If yes, need sec review.
Alex: No KMS changes; auth unchanged. I'll drop the perf harness and a short test script in the PR — gist: https://gist.github.com/alex/6a1b2c3. The shim preserves cache keys; fallback keeps old routing.
CI-Bot: CI: build passed. Integration tests: 2 flaky failures unrelated to routing (already triaged).
Mira: Cool. Can someone sketch a 3–4 line "arch-lite" note we can paste into the PR to unblock? If Jon can sign off with that, we can schedule a 1hr canary slot tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. :calendar:
Jon: Arch-lite: "Routing shim is backward-compatible; fallback to existing route guaranteed on errors; KV cache semantics preserved; minor p95 uplift expected during warm-up, mitigated by gradual rollout. Approve for canary with the proposed thresholds; ensure perf logs are attached." I'll drop that into the PR as an approval comment after I review the perf run.
Alex: Perfect — I'll schedule the 09:00 PT slot and add the canary steps to the release notes. Thanks all :pray:
Mira: Marking this thread as gated on the arch-lite note. Once Jon posts his perf OK + comment, we can mark for merge and flip the canary window.
Alex: Will follow up when perf run completes (ETA 4h).
